default.notes: A tourist visa is issued on arrival at airports and major land borders (about USD 50 in cash) under Mozambique's simplified border-visa regime — or apply in advance through the official eVisa portal (evisa.gov.mz) to avoid queues; conditions vary for some nationalities, so confirm before travel.

groups.notes: SADC citizens enter Mozambique visa-free for up to 30 days per visit.

Visa-free for tourism and business under Mozambique's 2023 waiver decree — up to 30 days per entry, with a small border-processing fee (about MZN 650) collected on arrival; the exemption list is periodically revised, so confirm eligibility before travel.

MZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Mozambican citizens.
